research_question: Is thematic similarity greater among preregistered high-traffic cases than among matched comparison sets within this corpus?
population_scope: Canonical cases with verified circulation outcomes and admissible multilingual lyric-theme representations.
robustness_plan: Repeat under alternative preregistered similarity representations and matched-set specifications; preserve every null or unstable result.
stop_promotion_rule: Undefined high-traffic threshold, inadmissible theme representation, imbalance, multiplicity failure, unstable similarity or replication failure blocks promotion.
blocked_reason: Neither the traffic classification nor a calibrated multilingual theme representation is admissible.
